title: Creation of Eberron, Khyber, and Siberys
sidebar: According to myth, the Progenitor Wyrms create reality and the thirteen planes. Khyber turns against the others and tears Siberys apart.

Eberron coils around Khyber and becomes the living world and prison of the Dragon Below. Siberys’s shattered body becomes the golden ring of dragonshards surrounding the world, while Khyber becomes the vast world beneath.

images.title: The Creation of Eberron, Khyber and Siberys

title: Couatls bind the demon lords beneath Khyber
sidebar: Recognizing that the war against Khyber’s fiends cannot otherwise be won, the couatls sacrifice most of their number to bind the most powerful demon lords and the majority of the fiends beneath Khyber.
The surviving dragons withdraw to Argonnessen to contemplate the Draconic Prophecy, leaving the bound fiends imprisoned below the world.

images.title: Couatls Bind the Demon Lords Beneath Khyber

title: Quori invade Xen’drik; Dal Quor is thrown out of planar alignment
sidebar: The quori invade Xen’drik from Dal Quor, the Plane of Dreams, beginning a devastating war against the giants.

The giants ultimately use immensely powerful magic to throw Dal Quor out of planar alignment and seal it away from Eberron. The magical backlash devastates Xen’drik and sinks large portions of the continent beneath the sea.

title: Vvaraak teaches druidic magic; the first Gatekeepers arise
sidebar: The dragon Vvaraak, acting in response to a portion of the Draconic Prophecy, begins teaching druidic magic to the orcs of western Khorvaire. These orcs become the first Gatekeeper druids.

The Gatekeepers are dedicated to protecting the natural world from extraplanar horrors, fiends, and aberrations. They maintain the ancient dimensional seals to hold back the Daelkyr and other extraplanar entities.
Note the Gatekeepers are a distinct group from the Watchers of the Gate.
Around the same era, the Dhakaani unite the goblinoid nations of Khorvaire into the great Dhakaani Empire.

images.title: Vvaraak Teaches Druidic Magic; the First Gatekeepers Arise

title: First Incursion / Daelkyr War
sidebar: The daelkyr invade Eberron from Xoriat, devastating western Khorvaire. The Gatekeeper druids ultimately defeat the invasion by sealing the portals to Xoriat and trapping the remaining daelkyr beneath the world.

The Wroat Military Library records identify this Daelkyr War as the First Incursion: the Dreamweaver first appears during the conflict and makes its first known attempt to build an empire in the material plane through large-scale possession.
Sources: Wroat Military Library Dreamweaver Books (played library information) + supplied Eberron setting timeline; -8,000 date supplied by the GM

images.title: The First Incursion: the Daelkyr War

title: House Vol is destroyed; Lady Vol becomes the lich Queen of the Dead
sidebar: Elves and dragons unite to destroy House Vol, the elven line that bears the Mark of Death, bringing the house to ruin.
Lady Vol survives as the lich Queen of the Dead.

images.title: House Vol Is Destroyed; Lady Vol Becomes the Lich Queen

title: The future Five Nations emerge
sidebar: Human settlements expand across central Khorvaire, carving territory out of lands still controlled by goblinoid peoples.
These settlements develop into the political foundations of the Five Nations that will later dominate central Khorvaire.

title: Second Incursion; The Twelve is established
sidebar: According to the Wroat Military Library records, the Second Incursion occurs when the Goblin Empire of Scurr is culled from the central landmass of Khorvaire.
Those records state that the Obelisk and the Gate are created during the Second Incursion as weapons intended to fight the Dreamweaver.
The dragonmarked houses establish the Twelve as a shared institution for cooperation, magical research and the development of dragonmarked industries.
Over the centuries, the Twelve becomes one of the central institutions behind the technological and arcane development of the dragonmarked houses.
Sources: Wroat Military Library Dreamweaver Books (played library information) + supplied Eberron setting timeline (Wizards of the Coast)

images.title: The Second Incursion; the Twelve Is Established

title: Founding of the Kingdom of Galifar
sidebar: The Kingdom of Galifar is established roughly four decades before the Third Incursion.
This date is an approximate reconstruction rather than a date stated directly in the Dreamweaver library text.

images.title: The Kingdom of Galifar Is Founded

title: Third Incursion
sidebar: Creed Odeon is described in the Wroat Military Library records as creating the Shadowmirror in an attempt to control the Dreamweaver, causing the Third Incursion.
Those records describe the Third Incursion as resulting in the destruction of the Kingdom of Galifar and the death of King Galifar I.
The Skull Knight is said in those records to end the Third Incursion using the Obelisk and the Gate.

title: Refounding / Reconstitution of Galifar
sidebar: The Kingdom of Galifar is reconstituted by Galifar II in the year 1, seven years after the Third Incursion.

title: The Church of the Silver Flame is founded
sidebar: The Church of the Silver Flame is founded, establishing the religious institution that will become one of the great powers of Khorvaire.
The faith later becomes especially dominant in Thrane and profoundly shapes the political and religious history of the continent.

images.title: The Church of the Silver Flame Is Founded

title: Alton Ardev founds Ardev
sidebar: Alton Ardev establishes the settlement that becomes Ardev as a refuge for drow, goblinoids and others rejected elsewhere.
The community grows both above and below ground, laying the foundation for modern Ardev and Lower Ardev.

title: Broadhelm Smithery is founded
sidebar: Ulnar and Kathla Broadhelm establish the Broadhelm Smithery in the Blackcap Mountains in 680 YK.
Over the following centuries the Broadhelm name grows into a household name across Breland, laying the foundation for Brand’s family legacy.

images.title: Ulnar and Kathla Broadhelm Found the Broadhelm Smithery

title: Brand Broadhelm is born
sidebar: Brand Broadhelm is born, approximately 215 years before the current campaign year.

title: The first lightning rail connects Flamekeep and Fairhaven
sidebar: The first lightning rail line begins operation, connecting Flamekeep in Thrane with Fairhaven in Aundair.
The new transportation system marks the beginning of the lightning rail network that will eventually bind much of central Khorvaire together.

images.title: The First Lightning Rail Runs from Flamekeep to Fairhaven

title: The Silver Purge begins
sidebar: The Church of the Silver Flame launches the great inquisition against Lycanthropes and Shifters, beginning the campaign later known as the Silver Purge.
The purge continues for roughly fifty years and kills virtually all Lycanthropes and Shifters across Khorvaire, leaving a lasting legacy of fear and persecution.

title: Brand enters Brelish military service
sidebar: The Brelish Army approaches the Broadhelms for an arms contract roughly 160 years before the campaign.
Brand takes the opportunity to represent the family directly, trains with the Brelish military and establishes his own military forge in Sharn.

title: King Jarot begins the central Khorvaire lightning-rail project
sidebar: King Jarot begins an ambitious public-works project intended to connect the heart of Khorvaire through an expanded lightning-rail network.
The project accelerates the transformation of the Five Nations into an increasingly interconnected industrial society.

images.title: King Jarot Begins the Central Lightning Rail Project

title: Lightning rail lines connect the Five Nations and neighboring regions
sidebar: The expanding lightning-rail network now connects the Five Nations with Zilargo, the Mror Holds and the Talenta Plains.
The system becomes one of the major arteries for civilian travel, commerce and military movement across Khorvaire.

images.title: The Lightning Rail Connects the Five Nations

title: King Jarot dies; the 100 Years War begins
sidebar: King Jarot of Galifar dies. The succession should pass to Mishann of Cyre, but several of her siblings reject the appointment.
The dispute fractures Galifar and the Five Nations turn the armies and new technologies amassed under Jarot against one another, beginning the 100 YearsWar.

images.title: King Jarot Dies, the War Begins

title: First conflict with Karrnath
sidebar: During the first battle of the 100 Years War and the first conflict with Karrnath, a squad wearing armor made by Brand is wiped out by an undead force.
Brand blames himself for their death and turns away from frontline service toward military engineering.

images.title: Brand's Armor Fails Against the Undead

title: Brand begins developing his prototype armor
sidebar: Brand begins developing a suit of armor intended not only to protect its wearer, but also the people around them.
The project combines Brand’s engineering skill with his devotion to Onatar and becomes the central work of the next forty years.

title: Kaius I allies Karrnath with the Blood of Vol and becomes a vampire
sidebar: Desperate to save Karrnath from the devastation of the War, Kaius I pledges his kingdom to the Blood of Vol.
The alliance brings Karrnath deeper into necromantic warfare, and Kaius I is transformed into a vampire by Vol.

images.title: Kaius I Pledges Karrnath to the Blood of Vol

title: Mobile Fortresses enter the war
sidebar: House Cannith creates the giant hovering mobile military bases.
By the current campaign Breland operates five of these fortress-scale military platforms.

title: The Grimdell family disappears from active operations
sidebar: The Grimdell necromancy family, already notorious for centuries of activity, disappears from the known conflict roughly twenty years into the War.

title: Thrane becomes a Silver Flame theocracy
sidebar: King Thalin of Thrane dies, and the Church of the Silver Flame assumes political control of the nation.
The Keeper of the Flame becomes Thrane’s supreme leader, establishing the theocratic government that rules the nation during the War.

images.title: Thrane Becomes a Silver Flame Theocracy

title: Brand completes his prototype armor
sidebar: After forty years of development, Brand completes a functioning prototype of his protective armor.
The prototype works, but he has not yet found a way to reproduce it safely and refuses to release the plans until he can.

title: Sazed is born
sidebar: Sazed is born, approximately 40 years before the current campaign year.

title: Brand Broadhelm is imprisoned
sidebar: After refusing to surrender his prototype armor plans, Brand is framed by Thaddeus d’Cannith and convicted of aiding and abetting a Thranish assassination attempt against King Boranex Ir’Wynarn.
Brand’s armor is confiscated and he begins the forty-year imprisonment that ends with the Darkwood campaign opening.

title: Ember begins work on Brand’s replacement armor
sidebar: After Brand is imprisoned in 953 YK, Ember Broadhelm begins work on a replacement suit for him. She continues refining it throughout his imprisonment; in 993 YK she reveals the unfinished armor at the Broadhelm Forge, where Brand’s Onatar-given core is able to power it.

title: Sazed’s childhood shifter village is destroyed by the Silver Flame
sidebar: At age seven, Sazed’s shifter village outside Passage is attacked and destroyed by Silver Flame forces, killing his family.
The children are hidden during the attack and later rescued by the Loreguards. Sazed is taken in and trained among them, beginning the path that shapes his later service.

title: King Boranex takes his own life; Boranel becomes King of Breland
sidebar: In 961 YK, King Boranex’s two eldest sons are killed fighting Aundair around Cragwar. A month later, already ailing and grief-stricken, Boranex takes his own life.
His third son Boranel is hurriedly summoned from Sharn and crowned King of Breland.

images.title: King Boranex Dies; Boranel Is Crowned

title: Boranex Forest is planted in King Boranex’s honor
sidebar: Shortly after King Boranex’s death, the forest outside Wroat is planted and named in his honor. By 993 YK, thirty-two years after his death, it has grown into a thriving forest.

title: House Cannith perfects the modern warforged
sidebar: House Cannith perfects the modern-era warforged: sentient living constructs designed for service in the War.
Their existence becomes increasingly important to the campaign through characters such as Clockwork, Mustang, Bulwark and the Right Hand.
Sources: Main campaign opening world primer + supplied Eberron setting timeline

title: The attack on Wroat / Day the Walls Fell
sidebar: Brelish military graves encountered by the party are dated from the 8th through the 13th of Eyre, 968 YK.
A Wroat memorial names 13 Eyre 968 as “The Day the Walls Fell.”

title: Haruuc’s rebellion creates Darguun
sidebar: Haruuc Shaarat’kor leads a hobgoblin rebellion against the forces of Cyre and Breland in southeastern Khorvaire.
The rebellion succeeds in creating the independent goblinoid nation of Darguun.

title: Battle of Fells Gate / Mindflayer Incursion
sidebar: A Mindflayer incursion from Khyber reaches toward the surface and is driven back by Brelish forces at Fells Gate.
Myconid forces then attack the battlefield with invasive spores, leaving the site contaminated and forcing Fells Gate to be sealed.
Geralt Gilderfawn’s journal, found decades later by the B-Team, records the aftermath from the 3rd through the 7th of Vult 969.

title: The Covenant of Emberfall is founded in Thrane
sidebar: The shifter village of FaltenStep is wiped out during a surge of Silver Flame extremism in Thrane. Shifters are driven from the country, and communities that refuse to leave are destroyed; Breland accepts shifters who flee across the border.
The Bloodsinger, son of FaltenStep’s village chief, responds by founding the Covenant of Emberfall and dedicating it to the preservation of the shifter bloodline.
The Covenant grows quickly among disaffected and radicalized shifters and becomes infamous in Thrane for attacks on the military, the Silver Flame church and the general populace.

As Thranish authorities close in, the Covenant slips across the border into Breland. Its ideology remains violently opposed to the Silver Flame and to the modern industrial society the Bloodsinger believes is destroying shifter life.

images.title: The Covenant of Emberfall Is Founded

title: Lirael is born
sidebar: Lirael is born, approximately 23 years before the current campaign year.

title: The Guns of Wroat are installed
sidebar: Breland installs the massive elemental artillery batteries known as the Guns of Wroat in reaction to the Day the Walls Fell.
Their presence becomes central to Wroat’s defenses and later helps make the Aundairian Skyfire Raid catastrophically expensive.

images.title: The Guns of Wroat Are Raised

title: The first Sentinel team is formed
sidebar: The surviving legacy of the Redcloak Battalion is reorganized into the first Sentinel team.
The B-Team learns this while crossing the old Fells Gate battlefield, turning the ruins into a direct piece of their own unit’s history.

title: Blazehelm disappears from public records
sidebar: Blazehelm vanishes from official records. Stories about the Brelish war hero continue among soldiers, while Aundair publicly claims he was never real even as its intelligence services continue to treat him as a possible living target.

title: Canuck (exact day not stated)
sidebar: A post-credits flashback shows teenage Delman Swordblade, years before he becomes Screech, living in the snowy village of Canuck.
Nine-year-old Cordy excitedly demonstrates new magic, accidentally escalating from harmless sparks to repeatedly firebolting Delman’s bed and model ship.
The scene establishes the affectionate sibling relationship between Screech and Cordy, and Canuck as a strangely insulated, wholesome corner of the setting.

images.title: Cordy Sets Screech's Bed on Fire

title: Elemental airships enter military service; Queen Aurala begins her reign of Aundair
sidebar: The first generation of practical elemental airships begins seeing combat. Aundair initially takes the lead in developing aerial warfare and builds the largest air fleet, beginning an escalating arms race among the Five Nations. In 980 YK, Queen Aurala begins her reign over Aundair.
Sources: Main campaign opening world primer; supplied Eberron setting timeline (Wizards of the Coast)

title: A shifter hideout known to Sazed is exposed
sidebar: A former shifter hideout known to Sazed is discovered or compromised. A decade later, during the lightning-rail crisis, Sazed chooses it as a place to hide the rescued shifters precisely because its age may make it less obvious.

title: The attack on Prowlstone / Battle of the Eldritch Groves
sidebar: While operating as a Loreguard undercover in the Brelish military under the guise of an Aundairian spy, Sazed learns that fighting is moving toward the shifter village of Prowlstone.
Instead of passing the military intelligence along as ordered, Sazed warns Prowlstone. The warning gives the village time to prepare and defend itself; Nedira is there when the warning arrives.
Years later, Prowlstone’s letters and drawings show marriages, births and children growing up — an entire generation whose lives were made possible by the warning.

Sazed’s decision blows his cover with the Brelish military, which identifies him as an Aundairian spy; his true allegiance as a Loreguard remains concealed. The Battle of the Eldritch Groves ends in a Brelish defeat, although Blazehelm later tells Sazed the battle was already a lost fight and his missing report did not cause the defeat.

title: Sazed is imprisoned
sidebar: Following the Prowlstone warning and the Battle of the Eldritch Groves, Sazed is detained after his Aundairian cover collapses.

Kynds visits him during the initial detention. Sazed is later transferred to Breland and begins roughly a decade of imprisonment, separated from the Loreguards and the communities he swore to protect.

title: The Grimdell family resurfaces
sidebar: After decades out of sight, the Grimdell family becomes an active problem again. By the opening of the campaign they are known to have worked with House Thuranni.

title: Willow disappears
sidebar: Willow warns the younger shifters to stop directly embezzling money and supplies from the Aundairian government, then disappears. Falken Sagewood tells Sazed in 993 YK that Willow has not been seen for eight years.

title: Hearthsfire is founded in Breland
sidebar: After Sazed is captured, younger Loreguards grow increasingly reckless, diverting Aundairian military money and supplies to shifter communities. Willow warns them to stop, then leaves without notice. In 985 YK, the aging elders abandon Aundair for safer Breland and found Hearthsfire, while the younger Loreguards remain behind—including Falken’s son Hale. Falken has not heard from Hale or the Aundairian clan in the eight years since; by 993 YK, only Falken and Spring remain of Hearthsfire’s founding elders.

title: The Daughters of Sora Kell invade western Breland
sidebar: The Daughters of Sora Kell lead an army of trolls, ogres, gnolls and other monstrous forces into western Breland.
The invasion establishes the military and political reality that will soon become the nation of Droaam on Breland’s western frontier.

images.title: The Daughters of Sora Kell Invade

title: Boranel abandons western Breland; Droaam declares sovereignty
sidebar: Unable to fight both Droaam’s forces and Breland’s enemies, King Boranel withdraws Brelish settlers and forces from the territory west of the Graywall Mountains.
The Daughters of Sora Kell declare the sovereignty of Droaam, permanently reshaping Breland’s western frontier.

title: Lirael Sr. begins his Dreamweaver investigation
sidebar: Lirael Sr., then a powerful wizard, Brelish general and head of the Ardev Magic Society, becomes obsessed with proving the Dreamweaver is real.
He comes to believe someone inside the Brelish military is trying to capture the entity and use it, and focuses increasingly on the Shadowmirror as the only thing capable of controlling it.
His research begins consuming his military duties and the direction of the Magic Society.

images.title: Lirael Sr Fixates on the Dreamweaver

title: Kaius III begins ruling Karrnath
sidebar: Kaius III begins his rule of Karrnath upon reaching his twentieth birthday.
He becomes the current reigning monarch of Karrnath.

images.title: Kaius III Takes the Throne of Karrnath

title: Lirael Sr. is discharged and disappears
sidebar: Lirael Sr. investigates military superiors, is caught and discharged after his behavior and conspiracy research overwhelm his normal duties.
He withdraws almost completely into the investigation, meets with the Watchers of the Gate in Starilaskur and then disappears.
His final hidden poem is dated the day before his disappearance, leaving a trail Lirael eventually begins following.

title: Xera receives a mysterious necklace in an unaddressed letter
sidebar: Xera Kel receives a necklace in an unaddressed letter. Roughly a year later, Lirael identifies the necklace as dangerous and asks her to give it to him.

title: Jaela Daran, age five, becomes Keeper of the Silver Flame
sidebar: At the age of five, Jaela Daran assumes the power and office of Keeper of the Silver Flame.
Her accession places a very young Keeper at the head of the Silver Flame and the Thranish government.

images.title: Jaela Daran Becomes Keeper of the Flame

title: Lirael is imprisoned after the Sharn Magic Society attack
sidebar: The Dreamweaver possesses Lirael during the Watchers of the Gate ritual at the Witches Waltz. Under its control, he kills the Watchers involved and burns their library.
Later, while still under Dreamweaver possession, Lirael goes to the Sharn Magic Society for his initiation. He attacks the society and kills its head, Vena Belladonna.
Lirael is imprisoned for the Sharn Magic Society attack and Vena Belladonna’s murder. At the start of the campaign he remembers only fragments; the full truth is recovered much later.

images.title: Massacre of the Watchers of the Gate

title: Glade leaves Hearthsfire and founds Stones Throw
sidebar: Glade Amberwood leaves Hearthsfire to create Stones Throw and pursue closer integration with Brelish society. Falken Sagewood says he warned Glade against the move.

title: The Skyfire Raid
sidebar: The Kason, with Norm Twosteel and Dwarzel Hellfoot aboard, spots a large Aundairian airship fleet approaching Wroat.
At the Guns of Wroat, Kal Valvier nervously mans the defenses while Captain Flowers steadies him.

Breland’s prepared air defenses and newer fleet blunt the Aundairian raid after a costly battle. The event later matters personally because the bombing killed Fogen Zaggerford, the former priest of the Hobbstweedle church.

title: Bravewind is attacked
sidebar: Bravewind is attacked. A changeling who escapes the village is later kidnapped and put through a possession portal; after being revived by the party, he identifies Bravewind and gives the date of the attack.

title: Richard and Bill disappear while heading toward Ardev
sidebar: Steve the Skycracker and Bob the Blazebringer say their sons Richard and Bill went missing roughly six weeks before the party’s return to Ardev. The young dragons were last seen heading toward Ardev.

title: Royal Ardev Regiment’s unrecorded exercise
sidebar: Shortly after the Hobbstweedle demon appearances, the Royal Ardev Regiment conducts a nighttime exercise in the Boranex Forest, supposedly a dry run for a torch-and-burn operation in Thrane.
Paxon later discovers there is no corresponding exercise or operation in the Wroat military records.
The regiment is disbanded four days later; several members never leave Breland and continue receiving military pay.
Gauss Hog later reveals that the training exercise was a cover story.
Captain Flowers later reveals the regiment had received a black order to destroy the demon portal outside Hobbstweedle, and he never learned who issued it.

images.title: Royal Ardev Regiment Destroys the Portal

title: Royal Ardev Regiment is disbanded
sidebar: The Royal Ardev Regiment is disbanded four days after its unrecorded Boranex Forest exercise.
The surviving paperwork later becomes a major clue because the regiment’s members remain in Breland and some continue receiving military pay despite the unit’s dissolution.

title: Captain Gelford Flowers is reassigned back to Ardev; the Dragon’s Claw arrives
sidebar: After the Royal Ardev Regiment is disbanded, Flowers is sent back to Ardev to replace the police captain who had recently died. Soon after his reassignment, Dragon’s Claw mercenaries arrive in Ardev.

images.title: Flowers Returns to Ardev; the Dragon's Claw Arrives

title: Darkwood Prison / campaign begins
sidebar: Brand, Lirael and Sazed are transferred into Darkwood Prison, beginning the campaign on the 6th of Zarantyr.

title: Darkwood Prison / campaign begins
sidebar: Their first day establishes the prison’s gangs, guards, torture and disappearing prisoners, along with early relationships involving Leff, Tauren, Sorenson, Keys, Faird, Elric, Gelf, Sheldor and the other prisoners around them.

title: Darkwood Prison / campaign begins
sidebar: Their equipment has been confiscated, Sazed is tortured, Lirael uses the sending stone and the party begins learning how the prison’s factions and guards fit together.

images.title: A Sending Stone Behind the Wall

title: Darkwood Prison / campaign begins
sidebar: By late on the 6th the prisoners are being moved toward the initiation known as Newbie Night, but the fight itself has not yet begun.

title: Newbie Night / Darkwood breakout / Mara’bor / Stones Throw destroyed by the Silver Flame
sidebar: At approximately 01:00, Newbie Night erupts into a fight and the party turns the initiation against the guards, beginning the prison break. The ensuing riot leads them through the prison, back to their confiscated gear and into the discovery of the necromancy operation before the battles with Grail Grimdell and his raised prisoners and guards end with the burning prison’s escape.

images.title: Initiation Night Becomes a Prison Break
Lirael Plays Both Sides of the Riot
Invisible Grail and the Meat Shield
Down from the Roof, Except Thaldamir
Cool Guys Don't Look at Explosions

title: Newbie Night / Darkwood breakout / Mara’bor / Stones Throw destroyed by the Silver Flame
sidebar: Following the DDT lead, the party reaches Mara’bor. Elric and Gelf reveal their connection to the Sentinels; after going to sleep around 06:30 and waking around 14:30, the party investigates the village, the Sharpe and Bloodworth leads and Grail’s hidden cellar, including the Bag of Devouring incident and contact with Grail’s brother.

images.title: Brand Remembers the Old King's Council
Bloodworth's Voice from the Abandoned House

title: Newbie Night / Darkwood breakout / Mara’bor / Stones Throw destroyed by the Silver Flame
sidebar: Through the afternoon and evening, Elric and Gelf reveal more about the Sentinels and the Darkwood operation while Damron searches Mara’bor for the party. The group hides in Grail’s cellar and stakes it out for his brother; the 7th ends with them waiting there immediately before Gelion Grimdell arrives at midnight. Elsewhere on the 7th, Stones Throw is destroyed by the Silver Flame.

title: Newbie Night / Darkwood breakout / Mara’bor / Stones Throw destroyed by the Silver Flame
sidebar: Player-only material on the same date shows Elerian blasted through the prison wall and killed, then revived by the awakened zombie Crek Lobo. Crek explains that he had tried to expose the domestic zombie-army operation before being mutilated and enslaved, and the two later find a tunnel leading deeper beneath the Yedani Mountains.

title: Gelion Grimdell / The Sentinels; Yedani Valley sabotage; Blazehelm party / Kason ambushed; crew captured
sidebar: At exactly 00:00, Gelion Grimdell arrives at the Mara’bor cellar. The party’s deception breaks into a fight; Gelion becomes an awakened zombie and is ultimately forced into the Bag of Devouring and consumed.

title: Gelion Grimdell / The Sentinels; Yedani Valley sabotage; Blazehelm party / Kason ambushed; crew captured
sidebar: The party emerges to find Mara’bor abandoned, releases the captured guards and leaves with Elric and Gelf. After roughly a forty-minute walk they reach the concealed Sentinel perimeter, meet Smildar Paxon and pass through the illusion surrounding the Kingsblade encampment at about 01:30.

title: Gelion Grimdell / The Sentinels; Yedani Valley sabotage; Blazehelm party / Kason ambushed; crew captured
sidebar: Major Renaud Blazehelm formally welcomes them, explains the Sentinels as a top-secret extra-judicial Brelish special-forces arm reporting only to the King and High Marshals, and debriefs the Darkwood operation and the Grimdell/Thuranni connections.

title: Gelion Grimdell / The Sentinels; Yedani Valley sabotage; Blazehelm party / Kason ambushed; crew captured
sidebar: Brand, Lirael and Sazed receive individual offers to join and meet more of the Kingsblade crew, including Screech, Feldor and Nedira; Sazed reveals his history as an Aundairian spy.

title: Gelion Grimdell / The Sentinels; Yedani Valley sabotage; Blazehelm party / Kason ambushed; crew captured
sidebar: The new Sentinels prepare to sabotage or capture the Aundairian Broadsword and Broadaxe. Their nightmares end with the giant eye telling them: “Found you.”

title: Gelion Grimdell / The Sentinels; Yedani Valley sabotage; Blazehelm party / Kason ambushed; crew captured
sidebar: Beginning around 14:30, the main party conducts the Yedani Valley airship sabotage mission, battles Aundairian forces and ultimately steals the ship that becomes the Moonwatch.

images.title: The Tripwire and the Red Flare
A Chicken in the Landing Gear

title: Gelion Grimdell / The Sentinels; Yedani Valley sabotage; Blazehelm party / Kason ambushed; crew captured
sidebar: The operation establishes the recurring Aundairian rivals Killian, Kynds, Darvok and EEEEE and further cements Screech as the party’s pilot.

images.title: EEEEE, the Dwarf in a Can

title: Gelion Grimdell / The Sentinels; Yedani Valley sabotage; Blazehelm party / Kason ambushed; crew captured
sidebar: Later that night the party celebrates at Blazehelm’s mansion in Hobbstweedle; many of the campaign’s long-term Sentinel relationships begin to settle into place.

images.title: How Blazehelm Knew: The King's Apology
The Beholder in the Entrance Hall
The Quasit in the Cowboy Hat
Nedira and the Village of Prowlstone
Valhalla Eriksson and the Ball Bearings
Blazehelm and the Sentinels Close Out

title: Gelion Grimdell / The Sentinels; Yedani Valley sabotage; Blazehelm party / Kason ambushed; crew captured
sidebar: Elsewhere, on the same day, the Brelish warship Kason is ambushed off Karrnath by three necromancer-led Karrnathi ships. The Kason sinks and Bulwark, Jyo, Norm and Dwarzel are captured.

title: Gelion Grimdell / The Sentinels; Yedani Valley sabotage; Blazehelm party / Kason ambushed; crew captured
sidebar: The Kason event is the beginning of the B-Team POW/Wraithwind storyline, although the main party does not experience it directly.

title: Sentinel training begins
sidebar: The party wakes after the celebration to another Hobbstweedle ordeal and begins formal Sentinel training.

images.title: The Polar Bear in the Ceiling
The Mirrored Door and the Red Key
The Stables Timer and the Kruthik
Blue Plus Yellow: The Invisible Key
Inverted Gravity and a Shrinking Door

title: Sentinel training begins
sidebar: Dyll Strickland runs the team through the obstacle course while the party experiments with the strange resources and personalities around the Sentinel base.

title: Sentinel training begins
sidebar: Sazed begins teaching Tauren to read in secret; Brand and Lirael begin potion-making; personal friendships with the wider Sentinel cast deepen.

images.title: Brand Argues with a Cleaning Gnome

title: Continued Sentinel training
sidebar: Sentinel training and downtime continue.

title: Continued Sentinel training
sidebar: The party acquires potion/herbalism supplies in Wroat as part of the later potion retcon.

images.title: No Potions Without an Herbalist Kit

title: Continued Sentinel training
sidebar: The Quasit problem around Hobbstweedle develops into a lead on a stranded demon settlement and broken portal.

title: Demon settlement destroyed; Dreamweaver infiltrates the Sentinels
sidebar: By 19:45 the party has located the Quasit/Imp/Cambion settlement and approaches it invisibly.

images.title: Creeping Into the Demon Village Unseen
Brand Walks Up to a Quasit

sidebar: They learn the demons were stranded when a portal failed and have been stealing to survive, giving the situation more nuance than a simple extermination mission.

images.title: Bells, Beans and Stolen Sentinel Gear

title: Demon settlement destroyed; Dreamweaver infiltrates the Sentinels
sidebar: Back in Hobbstweedle the party begins connecting the portal, Gelard Greenly and Lirael’s earlier possession history.

The First Bean Is a Coffee Geyser
Erald Reports on the Fart King
A Baby Morkoth Raids Brand's Room

Sheldor Insists on Going Back In

sidebar: The Dreamweaver threat becomes immediate when Sheldor and other Sentinels attack under possession; Lirael’s Detect Thoughts exposes the entity actively feeding lies through compromised minds.

images.title: Sheldor Shoves Brand in the Bag

title: Sentinel lockdown; Dreamweaver detection plan; Lirael Sr.’s research trail uncovered / Karrnathi crackdown begins in Orska
sidebar: At 07:00 the Sentinels are in a full internal-security crisis: they know Sheldor and Charlie Trundle are Dreamwoven but do not know how deep the infiltration goes.

title: Sentinel lockdown; Dreamweaver detection plan; Lirael Sr.’s research trail uncovered / Karrnathi crackdown begins in Orska
sidebar: Blazehelm locks down the information even from the High Marshals while the group works on covert ways to detect and remove possession.

images.title: Back to Training as If Nothing Happened

title: Sentinel lockdown; Dreamweaver detection plan; Lirael Sr.’s research trail uncovered / Karrnathi crackdown begins in Orska
sidebar: Lug Murzog is revived and cleared. Feldor and Eloria propose entering the victims’ dreams to fight the possession directly.

title: Sentinel lockdown; Dreamweaver detection plan; Lirael Sr.’s research trail uncovered / Karrnathi crackdown begins in Orska
sidebar: During interrogation, Sheldor and Charlie speak in unison through the Dreamweaver, address people hidden behind a two-way mirror and react to private comments, making it appear that the entity can somehow hear conversations on the other side of the glass.

images.title: The Dreamweaver Speaks Through Two Men

title: Sentinel lockdown; Dreamweaver detection plan; Lirael Sr.’s research trail uncovered / Karrnathi crackdown begins in Orska
sidebar: The party finds that Lirael Sr. had checked out the relevant Dreamweaver books before disappearing; Sazed encounters records taken from shifter clans destroyed during the Inquisition.

images.title: Every Book Checked Out by Lirael Sr
Sazed Finds the Stolen Shifter Books

title: Sentinel lockdown; Dreamweaver detection plan; Lirael Sr.’s research trail uncovered / Karrnathi crackdown begins in Orska
sidebar: In Karrnath, the military crackdown on Orska begins. Nybb later tells the B-Team that military police moved into the village two days before their 14 Zarantyr arrival because people had been leaving for the nearby druid village.

title: Brand possessed; Dream rescue frees possessed Sentinels
sidebar: Around midnight the player-only Brand possession sequence plays out: the Dreamweaver uses Brand to spread possession to Elric and Screech and attempts to expand its network.

images.title: Gelf Shoved Into the Astral Sea

title: Brand possessed; Dream rescue frees possessed Sentinels
sidebar: Clockwork proves unusually important because a construct that does not sleep or dream cannot be possessed through the normal Dreamweaver method.

images.title: The Book of Fire and the Run

title: Brand possessed; Dream rescue frees possessed Sentinels
sidebar: The possessed Sentinels make for the airfield and nearly steal the Kingsblade before the party and Clockwork’s forces stop them.

images.title: The Empty Jail and a Trail of Blood
Clockwork Lassos Gelf From the Void

title: Brand possessed; Dream rescue frees possessed Sentinels
sidebar: Brand is killed and revived to clear his possession. The party then uses Dream magic to enter their friends’ minds, kills a Dream Eater with a smokepowder bomb and frees the possessed Sentinels.

images.title: Brand Dies Just a Little Bit
A Brass Dragon Bursts From the Light

title: Brand possessed; Dream rescue frees possessed Sentinels
sidebar: The experience establishes that Dreamweaver possession has rules, can be detected and can be fought.

title: Lirael Sr. and Ardev investigation / POW rescue hunt begins
sidebar: Main-party Sentinel training and investigation continue, including leads tied to Lirael Sr., Ardev’s regiment and Wroat records.

images.title: Clockwork Has No Use for Sentiment

title: Lirael Sr. and Ardev investigation / POW rescue hunt begins
sidebar: Lirael meets Librarian Meriel after she finds one of Lirael Sr.’s stored items; she is murdered before reaching him. Paxon identifies the masked assassin as the Even Hand, and the party begins tracing both the assassin and the Royal Ardev Regiment.

title: Lirael Sr. and Ardev investigation / POW rescue hunt begins
sidebar: At 19:20, under the retconned B-Team chronology, Zak, Thoradin and Merbin deploy from the Pillar of Dawn into Karrnath to rescue the captured Kason POWs.

title: Lirael Sr. and Ardev investigation / POW rescue hunt begins
sidebar: They infiltrate the Zelbrus region, encounter Ervin Altaner, enter the militarized village of Orska and meet the informant Nybb Farkus.

title: Lirael Sr. and Ardev investigation / POW rescue hunt begins
sidebar: Kombrig Ubel’s crackdown escalates; Nybb is killed and the team becomes hunted while trying to locate the POW camp.

title: Even Hand encounter / B-Team — POW camp liberated
sidebar: The Wroat Military Library records room burns and Librarian Mercy is murdered. Murphy Gravewood is killed, Gauss Hog’s house is destroyed by an explosion, and the party pursues the Even Hand toward Kal Valvier.

images.title: Two Scrolls of Speak With Dead

title: Even Hand encounter / B-Team — POW camp liberated
sidebar: The main party races to protect Kal Valvier from the Even Hand. Kal is killed and revived repeatedly; the Even Hand ultimately decapitates him, leaving him dead at the end of the encounter before Click Clack mortally wounds the assassin’s warforged body.

images.title: Give Us Kal and Walk Away
Hunger of Hadar Takes the Assassins
Click Clack Splits The Even Hand
Rolick's Dust Finds the Last Imps
The Form They Definitely Shouldn't File
An Ardev Song on the Piano

title: Even Hand encounter / B-Team — POW camp liberated
sidebar: Clockwork determines that the Even Hand’s rune transmits his soul rather than containing it, making the victory temporary. Lirael recovers his father’s Obelisk and begins taking the old conspiracy more seriously.

images.title: Lirael Sr's Obelisk in Meriel's Bag
Blast Marks at the Broken Circle

title: Even Hand encounter / B-Team — POW camp liberated
sidebar: The party spends the evening with friends at Brew & Ale.

images.title: A Last Night at Brew and Ale

title: Even Hand encounter / B-Team — POW camp liberated
sidebar: In Karrnath, the B-Team reaches the POW operation, destroys the arcane AA gun and fights Doctor Volovsky and Kombrig Ubel.

title: Even Hand encounter / B-Team — POW camp liberated
sidebar: The POW camp is liberated and the Pillar of Dawn arrives, but Ubel blows the mine. The team goes back inside to rescue trapped prisoners.

title: Even Hand encounter / B-Team — POW camp liberated
sidebar: Deep in the mine a necromancer attempts to capture them; Merbin is killed and his heart is eaten. The surviving team escapes with the POWs and the Altaner family aboard the Pillar of Dawn.

title: Even Hand encounter / B-Team — POW camp liberated
sidebar: The Pillar of Dawn observes a large Karrnathi airship fleet rising and begins following it.

title: Hobbstweedle church service; Paxon prank
sidebar: After the late Brew & Ale night crosses midnight, the party endures another prison nightmare and trains with Feldor and Eloria on recognizing and controlling dreams, developing new tools for resisting the Dreamweaver.

images.title: The Brass Dragon Breaks the Prison

title: Hobbstweedle church service; Paxon prank
sidebar: The Even Hand leaves a silence arrow and taunting note at the party’s house. His trail disappears into the river/sewer system.

images.title: A Silence Arrow in the Door

title: Hobbstweedle church service; Paxon prank
sidebar: Clockwork begins designing sewer-crawling constructs while the party obtains maps and searches for another way to track him.

title: Hobbstweedle church service; Paxon prank
sidebar: Brand holds a service at the damaged Hobbstweedle church and learns more about the Skyfire Raid and the former priest killed in it.

title: Hobbstweedle church service; Paxon prank
sidebar: The party’s nightmares continue, but the Brass Dragon imagery increasingly acts as a counterforce.

images.title: The Brass Dragon Holds Back the Nightmares

title: Hobbstweedle church service; Paxon prank
sidebar: The group begins planning an elaborate prank against Paxon, pulling Eloria, Clockwork and the gnomes into it.

images.title: Eloria and Clockwork Join the Prank

title: Tomb of Centarrel discovered; Moonwatch departure preparations
sidebar: The Paxon prank escalates into an infiltration of Blazehelm’s mansion and the discovery/use of a portal connected to the Tomb of Centarrel.

title: Tomb of Centarrel discovered; Moonwatch departure preparations
sidebar: They find graves connected to people they know, including family ties to Gelf and Thaldamir.

title: Tomb of Centarrel discovered; Moonwatch departure preparations
sidebar: The party decides to fully explore the tomb later.

images.title: Clockwork Wyrmlings and a Dragon Skull

title: Tomb of Centarrel discovered; Moonwatch departure preparations
sidebar: That night, the altered Paxon painting is hung inside Blazehelm’s mansion; the public unveiling is planned for the following morning.

images.title: Hanging the Portrait Under a Beholder

title: Moonwatch departs for Ardev
sidebar: At 08:00 the party unveils the altered Paxon painting at Blazehelm’s mansion, humiliating Paxon before the assembled Sentinels.

title: Moonwatch departs for Ardev
sidebar: Before liftoff, Blazehelm tells Brand that Bellatrix Snaggletooth and her roommate have been murdered, with a note left behind.

title: Moonwatch departs for Ardev
sidebar: At about 12:18 the Moonwatch takes off from Hobbstweedle for Ardev, marking the beginning of the Ardev arc.

title: Moonwatch departs for Ardev
sidebar: On the flight Brand detects evil from mirrors and Lirael experiences increasingly severe nightmare flashes when looking into them.

title: Moonwatch departs for Ardev
sidebar: The crew throws most mirrors overboard and begins treating mirrors as a possible Dreamweaver vector.

title: Moonwatch departs for Ardev
sidebar: Sorenson opens up about his fear of dying and uncertainty about Sentinel life; the Moonwatch increasingly becomes the campaign’s shared home.

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: In Ardev the main party digs deeply into Lirael Sr.’s trail. After solving his bizarre library puzzle, they descend through an anti-magic field into his hidden office, where a slaad posing as Lirael Sr. attacks before being killed.

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: The hidden den yields more of Lirael Sr.’s Dreamweaver investigation: an Obelisk pedestal, disguised Wroat Military Library books, and evidence of how far his obsession had consumed him. The recovered books reveal more about the Dreamweaver before the party stops at the warning, “Beware of Knowledge.”

images.title: I Pray the Worst Has Come

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: At the Ardev library, Sazed finds Carrk’s hidden message that Stones Throw has been destroyed and that Carrk is heading toward Hearthsfire.

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: By late evening the party is working at Turckle & Churckle. Lirael reconnects awkwardly with Xera and tries to repair his relationship with Felicia Jr.; after an argument, Felicia storms out and disappears before Turckle can bring her home.

images.title: Trouble at the Turckle and Churckle
The Right Hand at the Cannith Forge

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: The search for Felicia leads to Lirael’s trashed family home, where the party finds Turckle’s flask, Felicia’s purse and the teleportation ring that sent Gynn to the Gorgis house. Following the trail across Ardev, they learn a Glabrezu had been seen carrying two bodies.

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: A druid contact then draws Sazed into the forest to meet the Bloodsinger and the Covenant of Emberfall. He learns they are working with the Dragon’s Claw only as a means to an end and that a Fury-linked darkness is spreading through Ardev, with Fark’s Bargain Whores singled out as a dangerous focal point. Felicia remains missing as the party returns to the Moonwatch for the night.

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: At the same time, a major air battle erupts near the Brelish border. Bulwark and Jyo are prisoners aboard the Wraithwind.

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: In parallel, Zak, Thoradin and the Pillar of Dawn Sentinels assault and bring down the Hellswind, rescuing the remaining POWs aboard and recovering intelligence later used to track the Karrnathi rear squadron in Khyber.

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: Grave Grimdell sends Bulwark and Jyo to a mysterious Astral prison containing a gyroscopic device; Jyo is assaulted by the Dreamweaver.

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: They bluff Grave into believing they are possessed. Grave describes the Dreamweaver’s infiltration as being directed by The Shepherd, reveals the plan to use them to infiltrate the Sentinels, and explains that the Sentinels are difficult to influence indirectly through possessed high-ranking officers.

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: The rescue teams converge, the Wraithwind is destroyed, Bulwark and Jyo reunite with the surviving Kason crew, and Captain Markus recruits them into the Sentinels.

title: Lirael Sr.’s hidden office; Covenant meeting / Wraithwind destroyed; Bulwark and Jyo join Sentinels
sidebar: The surviving Karrnathi fleet descends into Black Pit and enters Khyber.

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: Early in the day Lirael steals the latest Ardev Watch hit-piece before it can circulate while invisible Dragon’s Claw mercenaries shadow the party. The search for Felicia Jr. leads to an abandoned house saturated with demonic activity and a sealed passage into the lost Mausoleum of Alton Ardev.

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: Inside, the party learns more of Alton Ardev’s founding ideals, deals with demons, traps and Shrimp Diggery, and discovers the ritual at the heart of the disappearances.

images.title: Heeby Deeby Dee, You Killed Me

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: Turckle, the Gorgises, Neer, Elk and the draft dodgers they had hidden have been murdered for the ritual. Felicia Jr. is bound above a demon portal while Fark and Gynn attempt to make her a vessel for the Fury.

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: The party breaks the ritual, frees Felicia and kills Fark and Gynn. The ordeal awakens Felicia’s latent sorcery amid severe trauma, while surviving Abishai move to restart the portal and an enlarged Bone Devil hunts the group through the mausoleum toward the underground river.

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: The party escapes through the underground river to Ardev’s lake and immediately mobilizes the town. Captain Flowers brings the police; the Right Hand, Morganth and the Dragon’s Claw arrive with Brokk and Barry; the Bloodsinger brings druids; and Auntie Bees arrives with her swarm.

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: When the Bone Devil tears its way to the surface and summons a second devil, the uneasy alliance fights together to defend Ardev and destroys both. The party then returns below, kills the Abishai attempting to reactivate the portal and leaves the mausoleum under Oberoth’s order.

images.title: All of Ardev vs the Bone Devils

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: Later, the Magic Society meeting leaves the party deeply suspicious of Fey-Lynn and her Dreamweaver theory. That night they secretly visit the ruins of Stones Throw, learn the attackers were Silver Flame warriors from outside Ardev, and rescue Skye Amberwood and eight younger shifter children from a hidden refuge beneath the well.

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: Meanwhile, at 09:13 the B-Team begins the Khyber Hunt. The Altaner family receives Brelish refugee status and leaves for Starilaskur.

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: Bulwark/Jyo and Zak/Thoradin are split into two teams to locate the crashed Boundless and the Karrnathi rear squadron before Khyber shifts.

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: Zak and Bulwark cross the old Fells Gate battlefield, survive an invisible minefield and a myconid-corrupted Neothelid, and use an abandoned Apparatus of Kwalish to escape.

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: They find the Boundless survivors Cordy, Banjo and the zombifying Cyric. Cyric later sacrifices himself to let the others escape.

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: The group reaches Crypt Haven, uncovers the hag/revenant ambush, frees Jyo and Thoradin, and learns the Karrnathi fleet appears to possess a way to navigate Khyber’s shifts.

title: Felicia Jr. rescued; Stones Throw survivors rescued / Boundless survivors found; Cyric sacrifices himself
sidebar: By 18:30 the B-Team is moving toward the Mouth of the World Scar with the surviving Boundless crew.

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: At 06:40 Lirael reads Fey-Lynn’s mind and discovers she is Dreamwoven and beginning “phase 2.” The attempt to protect Xera and Felicia Sr. collapses into the Even Hand/Flock operation.

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: Mustang is revealed as one of the Even Hand’s warforged bodies. The Even Hand and Mustang jointly decapitate Xera and Fey-Lynn before Brand activates the body’s personality core; afterward, Mustang’s independent personality turns against the Even Hand and warns the party it is a trap. Felicia Sr. and Lirael are taken/possessed, and the party is dragged into the lightning-rail/mobile-fortress crisis.

images.title: Ball Bearings and an Arcane Safe

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: The Skull Knight intervenes, judges the party worthy to carry the Gate and Obelisk, tells them Lirael Sr. carried them before, and later enters Lirael’s dream prison to free him.

images.title: Do You Know Its True Name?

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: By early afternoon the rail is racing toward the invisible turtle fortress while the Moonwatch is under AA fire and the party fights the Flock. The party escapes the catastrophe and begins recovering in Ardev.

images.title: A Bear Army and a Pigeon
The Train Hits the Turtle Fortress

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: Dreamwoven Telos and Gruff tear Jyo apart during the escape; the party kills the bears moments too late and recovers Jyo’s remains for possible revival.

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: By 21:12 they are speaking with Wilford Chism at the Silver Flame church, trying to make sense of the Fury’s disappearance, the town’s lockdown and the many people who now need to be rescued or revived.

images.title: The Valvier House, Torched and Picked Over
Jazz Learns Mustang Was the Even Hand
The Gold Under a False Name

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: In Khyber at 06:30, the B-Team wakes to find Jyo missing and a sinkhole beside the camp. He later emerges in Ardev, directly linking the B-Team crisis to the main-party events.

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: In Khyber, at 06:30–06:32, the B-Team infiltrates the Karrnathi rear squadron at the Mouth of the World Scar, plants bombs, steals the Khyber map from the Black Steed and plants the tracking charm, and is forced to steal the Eternal Night after Vulture’s Kunai is shot down.

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: The Eternal Night fights the Soul Reaver as the wider Brelish/Karrnathi fleet battle erupts over Gol Ignis. Gazriel Grimdell and undead Captain Hawktooth board the ship. Zak Thunderwaves Hawktooth into Gol Ignis.

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: Bulwark suplexes Gazriel into Thoradin’s moonbeam, turning him to dust.

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: The smokepowder bomb aboard the Soul Reaver destroys its elemental engine, frees its bound shadow elemental, and sends the crippled Viper crashing into Gol Ignis, where the lava consumes it.

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: Foehammer and Monty deliver the experimental invisibility drive; the reconstituted Zyborg Volovsky attacks with Sidewinders and zombie bursters. Thoradin saves Foehammer from falling into the lava, and Bulwark kicks Volovsky from the Eternal Night, but a Sidewinder rescues him.

title: Mustang revealed as an Even Hand body; train and turtle-fortress crisis / Gol Ignis battle
sidebar: Monty activates the invisibility drive. The Eternal Night survives the battle and reaches the Brelish fleet as Khyber shifts: the Karrnathi side is pulled toward a twisting green bog while the Brelish fleet shifts upward into the purple Mycenia Vasts.

title: Hearthsfire arrival; meeting with Ember; Aundairians captured; Forge attack
sidebar: The party repairs the Moonwatch, revives Xera/Fey-Lynn, deals with Felicia Sr.’s continuing possession and follows several Ardev leads.

images.title: Carrk's Cloak Connects to Another Plane

title: Hearthsfire arrival; meeting with Ember; Aundairians captured; Forge attack
sidebar: Sazed brings the surviving Stones Throw children to Hearthsfire. Skye chooses Sazed as her Loreguard mentor, while Carrk’s story and behavior become increasingly suspicious.

images.title: The Children of Stones Throw Come Home

title: Hearthsfire arrival; meeting with Ember; Aundairians captured; Forge attack
sidebar: The party learns more about the shifter ideological divide, the Covenant of Emberfall and Falken’s warnings about changelings seeking refuge among shifter communities.

title: Hearthsfire arrival; meeting with Ember; Aundairians captured; Forge attack
sidebar: The party reaches Starilaskur in the evening, confronts the EPTF with evidence of the Dreamweaver and learns that the Fury cried out in anguish when the Watchers lost their powers.

images.title: The Truth Amulet at the EPTF

title: Hearthsfire arrival; meeting with Ember; Aundairians captured; Forge attack
sidebar: At the Military Library they discover Gelard Greenly has been researching the Dreamweaver and possession; Sazed studies trance states.

title: Hearthsfire arrival; meeting with Ember; Aundairians captured; Forge attack
sidebar: Brand reunites with Ember Broadhelm, learns how his forty-year imprisonment fractured the family and activates the armor Ember spent forty years building for him.

images.title: Joke Potions and a Goblin Brand

title: Hearthsfire arrival; meeting with Ember; Aundairians captured; Forge attack
sidebar: The Aundairian rivals unexpectedly reappear. EEEEE is killed, Killian and Darvok are captured and Kynds escapes.

images.title: Mine Cart, Crane, Roof, Living Room
The Rod, Elwood and the Axe

title: Hearthsfire arrival; meeting with Ember; Aundairians captured; Forge attack
sidebar: The investigation into the mysterious decommissioned rail leads to stationmaster Chaton E’Clair, but changelings assassinate him before questioning and then attack the Broadhelm Forge with another bomb and a Gorgon.

images.title: Stowaways in a Bag of Holding
Orange Fur on the Cleared Track
Off the Cliff, Into the Gorgon

title: Witches Waltz truth recovered; return to Ardev
sidebar: Around 01:30 the Starilaskur aftermath continues under the EPTF defensive barrier. Lirael returns to the Witches Waltz and recovers the truth of the massacre: the Dreamweaver possessed him during the Watchers’ ritual and used him to kill them. Kynds also returns for Killian, who is released without another fight.

title: Witches Waltz truth recovered; return to Ardev
sidebar: The party convinces Captain Dane to release Elfina Daelmourn from EPTF custody. Elfina accompanies them to the Witches Waltz.

title: Witches Waltz truth recovered; return to Ardev
sidebar: Kynds returns to the Moonwatch with Aundairian hobgoblins to recover Killian. The confrontation ends without a bloodbath when the party gives Killian back.

title: Witches Waltz truth recovered; return to Ardev
sidebar: At 03:30 the Moonwatch leaves Starilaskur for the eight-hour flight back to Ardev.

title: Witches Waltz truth recovered; return to Ardev
sidebar: Sazed speaks openly with Eloria about Skye and his divided loyalties, and at 03:30 the Moonwatch begins the eight-hour flight back to Ardev.

images.title: A Room for Elfina, a Kiss for Sazed

title: Witches Waltz truth recovered; return to Ardev
sidebar: On arrival, the party finds Thaddeus d’Cannith’s Empyrean occupying their usual berth and Ardev preparing for his speech. The Bloodsinger sends Skye an Animal Messenger calling her the Lighted One and asking her to bring Sazed, the Guarded One, to Stones Throw; the party decides to go after Thaddeus’s speech.

images.title: A Message for the Lighted One

title: Witches Waltz truth recovered; return to Ardev
sidebar: Fey-Lynn, now stable enough to discuss her possession, explains the Dreamweaver’s plan: steer the Magic Society toward Karrnath, discredit Lirael Sr., monitor the Xal’ris, capture Lirael’s mother and eventually kill the party.

title: Witches Waltz truth recovered; return to Ardev
sidebar: Wilford arrives frightened after an ominous divine warning and is allowed to stay aboard the Moonwatch.

title: Witches Waltz truth recovered; return to Ardev
sidebar: Skye learns that Silver Flame forces destroyed Stones Throw, while Wilford Chism’s behavior and explanation of Reconciliation Day reinforce that Ardev’s elderly local congregation is very different from the force that attacked the village.

title: Witches Waltz truth recovered; return to Ardev
sidebar: Sorenson reports on the new Cannith recording studio and dinner aboard the Empyrean, including Thaddeus’s anti-magic amulet; Barry Baritone has since disappeared. The ritual’s deaths have also left Turckle & Churckle deteriorating under Neebus.

images.title: The Last of the Gorgis Family

title: Witches Waltz truth recovered; return to Ardev
sidebar: Captain Flowers reveals the Royal Ardev Regiment was given a black order to destroy the Hobbstweedle demon portal under cover of a training exercise and was disbanded afterward. Using Flowers’s sending stone, the party speaks with Morganth, who asks them to avoid incidents and keep the Moonwatch grounded while Thaddeus and Art review the town’s police/mercenary integration.
